name: Pillar Stance
description: Stand square with the weight on both heels and qi running up the spine like a pillar.

name: Pair Fist
description: Throw two fists in the school's pairing so the second follows the first into the same opening.

name: Pillar Walk
description: Advance in the school's upright step with the spine straight and each foot placed like a column base.

name: Stone Pair
description: Raise two low stones that close about the foe's ankles one after the other.

name: Twin Thrust
description: Drive two narrow spears of rock up from the ground at the same target a heartbeat apart.

name: Pillar Ward
description: Stand a pillar at the user's shoulder to take the strike the school's guard has turned aside.

name: Colonnade Rise
description: Raise a rank of pillars in a row so they trap everyone caught between them.

name: Pillar Fall
description: Lift a pillar and topple it onto the foe with the full weight of the school's training.

name: Pillar Judgment
description: Raise two great pillars through the qi field and bring them down so the foe is struck and held beneath.

name: Pillar Doom
description: The school's closing move that sets pillars on both sides of the foe and drops them with a weight scaled to the user's reserve.

name: Guard Pair
description: Hold the left forearm and the right forearm as two separate stone guards covering different lines.

name: Match Strike
description: Answer a blow by striking at the same height with the opposite hand and a hardened wrist.

name: Guard Step
description: Move a half pace to place a guard where the next blow will fall.

name: Paired Guard
description: Raise two stone plates in a staggered pair so a blow that breaks the first meets the second.

name: Stone Rebuff
description: Meet a swing with a rising stone face that sends it wide of the body.

name: Guard Break
description: Smash the foe's guard with a hardened forearm so the arm behind it goes numb.

name: Matched Ward
description: Stand beside an ally and share one stone guard that covers both and steadies the pair.

name: Unbreaking Pair
description: Hold two interlocked stone guards through a long assault until the attackers' arms give out.

name: Guard Crush
description: Close both guards on the foe's weapon and crush it against the school's plate.

name: Twin Colossi
description: Raise two mountain-sized shoulders of rock beside the user to guard and then burst outward.

name: Bedrock Pair
description: The school's defining move in which the second guard returns the force the first guard took with strength that scales with the blow absorbed.

name: Cairn Stack
description: Pile three flat stones in front of the body with a pulse of qi so a blow must break them all.

name: Blue Cobble
description: Flick a pale stone from a cairn pile at the foe with the school's quick wrist.

name: Cairn Mark
description: Set a small cairn on the foe's path so the stones lock round any foot that touches it.

name: Cairn Step
description: Climb a rising stack of stones in two steps and drop to the far side.

name: Stacked Stones
description: Pile a tall stack of stones before the user that settles and tightens under each blow.

name: Cairn Fall
description: Topple a high cairn onto a group so the stones tumble and strike all beneath.

name: Marked Cairn
description: Leave small cairns about the field and read through each the footfalls that pass near it.

name: Cairn Spire
description: Shape the top stone of a cairn into a spire and fire it into the foe.

name: Azure Cairn
description: Raise a great cairn of pale stone about the user that guards the party and strengthens their footing.

name: Cairn Collapse
description: Bring down every cairn in the field at once so a heavy rain of stone covers the foes.

name: Cairn Titan
description: Stack a titan of stone through the qi field and send its fist crashing onto the foe.

name: Cairn Crown
description: The school's crowning move that heaps every cairn into one great crown and drops it with a weight that grows with the stones gathered.

name: Cupped Knuckle
description: Strike with a cupped palm and let the qi stored in the hollow pour into the target.

name: Skipping Stone
description: Throw a smooth rounded stone with a flowing underhand arc that skips and then strikes.

name: Downslope Step
description: Slip downslope on a trickle of loosened soil and come up balanced beside the foe.

name: Cupped Charge
description: Pour earth qi into a hollow behind the breastbone until the basin is full and ready.

name: Silt Clasp
description: Draw the school's river silt up round the foe's legs and set it stiff.

name: Foundation Pour
description: Pour a heavy stream of stone from the raised hands across the ground ahead.

name: Foundation Stream
description: Keep a stream of grinding stone running across the field to carry foes off their feet.

name: Deep Bowl
description: Open a deep basin beneath the user's feet that drinks blows and returns them as strength.

name: Silt Torrent
description: Break the held basin open and let a torrent of rock and silt tear across the whole field.

name: Foundation Flood
description: The school's great flood that empties the basin along the river and buries the field under a load scaled to the qi stored.

name: Crown Stance
description: Hold a tall settled stance with qi gathered at the crown of the head and the soles at once.

name: Twin Crest
description: Strike with both fists meeting at the summit of the swing for a clean heavy blow.

name: Weighty Pace
description: Advance with a slow weighty pace that shakes the ground a little at every footfall.

name: Dual Spires
description: Raise a peak at each side and strike along the valley between them.

name: Crown Wedge
description: Raise a long ridge between user and foe and press it slowly against the foe.

name: Crown Ward
description: Gather rock into a summit above the head and shed blows down its slopes.

name: Column Ascent
description: Raise a column under the feet and ride it up to meet a high foe.

name: Granite Crown
description: Wear a crown of rock that shields the user and steadies the whole body against any shove.

name: Crown Drop
description: Drop a peak's summit onto the foe from above in one tremendous fall.

name: Crowned Mass
description: Heave a whole crowned peak out of the ground and let it fall across the foes in a thundering ring.

name: Crown Cataclysm
description: The school's highest move that joins both tracks at the crown and drops a mountain with a weight scaled to the user's core.

name: Oath Brace
description: Lean into the stance with a sworn word on the breath and let the oath hold the posture.

name: Gale Palm
description: Strike with the school's open palm and push the force through like a gust through a gap.

name: Earthen Pace
description: Advance a measured pace for each word of the oath and never lose the line.

name: Gale Marker
description: Set a stone marker upwind and read the wind's force by how the marker shakes.

name: Sworn Mass
description: Press the sworn word into the ground until the whole body gains weight.

name: Gale Fist
description: Throw a fist carrying a short gust of grit that blinds as it lands.

name: Oathbound Stance
description: Hold the sworn stance so firmly that gusts and shoves slide off and strikes come heavier.

name: Gale Deflection
description: Angle a stone forearm into an incoming blow and ride it off on the wind.

name: Vow Stroke
description: Let the whole oath fall into a single blow so the strike lands with the weight of every word.

name: Gale Vow
description: Swear against the wind and hold the line so that wind and foe alike are pressed back.

name: Oath Tempest
description: Raise the oath into a storm of stone and gale that tears across the whole field.

name: Oath Descent
description: The school's last move in which the sworn weight descends all at once on the foe with a force bound to the vow made.

name: Level Brace
description: Stand flat and wide with the knees soft so a shove finds no angle to work.

name: Slab Palm
description: Strike with a palm hardened to a flat slab and driven straight from the shoulder.

name: Flat Pace
description: Move across the ground in even short paces that never lift the heel far.

name: Foundation Stone
description: Set a broad foundation stone under the feet that bears the user and strengthens every guard.

name: Level Strike
description: Bring a flat slab across at hip height to strike the foe's whole side at once.

name: Slab Lift
description: Heave a broad slab up beneath the foe's feet to topple their stance.

name: Held Foundation
description: Hold the great slab beneath so steady that nothing thrown against the user shakes it.

name: Slab Crush
description: Bring the whole slab down in one flat crushing blow on the group before the user.

name: Foundation Colossus
description: Raise a colossus of stone from the foundation and let it stride across the ground it stands on.

name: Foundation Ruin
description: The school's hardest move that turns the foundation on the foe and breaks all above it with a force set by the qi stored.

name: Steady Brace
description: Fix the stance along a straight line and let the line carry the weight of a blow.

name: Aimed Fist
description: Throw a fist along the drawn line so the blow arrives where the line ends.

name: Straight Pace
description: Walk the drawn line in even paces and turn only when the line turns.

name: Spike Drive
description: Drive a spike of stone along the line so it pierces whatever stands on it.

name: Steady Pillar
description: Plant a pillar on the line to catch a blow aimed along it.

name: Gripping Mark
description: Draw a line across the ground that grips any foot crossing it and holds it fast.

name: Stone Reader
description: Follow the drawn line out through the stone and read the weight of each thing that touches it.

name: Unbent Strike
description: Strike straight down the line so the blow cannot be dodged sideways and holds the foe pinned.

name: Rolling Quake
description: Send a quake down the whole length of the line to shake everything that stands beside it.

name: Toppling Monolith
description: Raise a monolith at the far end of the line and topple it back along the line onto the foe.

name: Lance Reckoning
description: The school's reckoning that runs the whole line through the foe in one thrust whose depth rises with the qi gathered along it.

name: Bedrock Brace
description: Plant the stance on the school's mountain footing and let the force of a blow die in it.

name: Vow Palm
description: Strike with a palm hardened by the school's oath and thrust from the legs.

name: Granite Step
description: Place the foot on a raised line of stone and cross rough ground without falling.

name: Basalt Vow
description: Swear the body to a mountain and gain its steadiness against both gale and blade.

name: Gale Quake
description: Stamp the ground as the gale rises and send a shake through the wind-blown grit.

name: Wind Bound
description: Pin the foe's cloak and limbs to the ground with stones the wind has thrown.

name: Rock Rebuff
description: Meet a rushing blow with a face of rock and send its full force back on the one who threw it.

name: Gale Mass
description: Lay the weight of a mountain and the pressure of a gale on a single foe.

name: Sworn Spire
description: Raise a sworn peak through the field and let it fall as the gale reaches its height.

name: Covenant Tempest
description: The school's tempest in which wind and mountain fall together on the field with a power bound to the oath of the user.

name: Deep Brace
description: Sink the stance so low that the qi reaches the rock below the soil and holds the body fast.

name: Under Fist
description: Strike upward from beneath the guard with a fist driven by the legs and the ground.

name: Buried Step
description: Press off a buried stone and let the earth give back the force as a long low step.

name: Under Listen
description: Listen through the deep rock for the weight and number of those who move above.

name: Buried Oath
description: Bury the sworn word in the bedrock and draw on it for strength and a firmer guard.

name: Rising Vow
description: Send a lance of bedrock up through the soil exactly beneath the foe.

name: Under Quake
description: Strike the deep stone and let the quake rise to shake all who stand above it.

name: Depth Hold
description: Pull the foe's feet down into the ground and hold them in the stone.

name: Beneath Strike
description: Bring a pillar of bedrock up from far below and strike the foe from underneath.

name: Deep Oath
description: Hold the deep oath over a group so the ground itself sinks beneath their weight.

name: Bedrock Vow
description: Bind the bedrock to the vow so that it shields the user and presses down the foes.

name: Oath Eruption
description: The school's deepest move that frees the oath from far below as a rising eruption whose force follows the depth of the vow.
